description: This file defines a class PerplexityChatConfig that customizes and extends a base OpenAIGPTConfig to support Perplexity's chat API, including response transformation, usage enhancement, and citation annotation processing.

classes.name: PerplexityChatConfig
classes.description: A configuration class for integrating Perplexity's chat API with custom response handling and annotation processing, extending the OpenAIGPTConfig class.

methods.name: Tuple[Optional[str],Optional[str]] _get_openai_compatible_provider_info( self, api_base: Optional[str], api_key: Optional[str] )
methods.description: Retrieves the API base URL and API key for Perplexity, defaulting to secret manager values or hardcoded defaults.

methods.name: list get_supported_openai_params(self, model: str)
methods.description: Returns a list of supported OpenAI parameters that Perplexity API supports, including conditional addition of reasoning and web search options.

methods.name: ModelResponse transform_response( self, model: str, raw_response: httpx.Response, model_response: ModelResponse, logging_obj: LiteLLMLoggingObj, request_data: dict, messages: List[AllMessageValues], optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, encoding: Any, api_key: Optional[str] = None, json_mode: Optional[bool] = None, )
methods.description: Transforms the raw API response into a ModelResponse object, and enhances it with Perplexity-specific fields including citations and search queries, also annotates citations in the message.

methods.name: None _enhance_usage_with_perplexity_fields( self, model_response: ModelResponse, raw_response_json: dict )
methods.description: Extracts citation tokens and search query counts from the response JSON, updating the usage object.

methods.name: None _add_citations_as_annotations( self, model_response: ModelResponse, raw_response_json: dict )
methods.description: Extracts citation and search result info from the response JSON and adds URL citations as annotations in the message.
